import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def task_func(matrix1, matrix2):
    matrix1 = np.asarray(matrix1)
    matrix2 = np.asarray(matrix2)

    if matrix1.ndim != 2 or matrix2.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Both inputs must be 2D arrays.")

    if matrix1.shape[0] != matrix2.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError("Both matrices must have the same number of rows.")

    combined = np.concatenate((matrix1, matrix2), axis=1)
    df = pd.DataFrame(combined)
    return df.to_string(index=False, header=False)
